Interface Update

All Superinterfaces:
ClientMessage, Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
CardPickedUpdate, EndGameUpdate, ErrorMessageUpdate, EventUpdate, GameResumedUpdate, GameSuspendedUpdate, LeaderboardUpdate, PingRequest, PlayerDisconnectedUpdate, PlayerJoinedUpdate, PlayerReconnectedUpdate, StateChangedUpdate, TotemColorUpdate, TotemPlacedUpdate, TotemReturnedUpdate, TurnChangedUpdate
public sealed interface Update extends ClientMessage permits StateChangedUpdate, PlayerJoinedUpdate, PlayerDisconnectedUpdate, PlayerReconnectedUpdate, TotemPlacedUpdate, TotemColorUpdate, TotemReturnedUpdate, CardPickedUpdate, TurnChangedUpdate, EndGameUpdate, EventUpdate, ErrorMessageUpdate, LeaderboardUpdate, GameSuspendedUpdate, GameResumedUpdate, PingRequest
Update message sent by the server (SERVER -> CLIENT).

POLYMORPHIC DISPATCH: each subtype implements applyTo(ClientModel), eliminating switch/if-else in the client-side handler. Thanks to sealed, the compiler guarantees exhaustive coverage.

Exception: StateChangedUpdate has additional logic in the handler (ServerHandler.handleUpdate) to trigger GUI scene switching when moving from lobby to game. Model vs UI responsibility remains separated: applyTo() updates the model, the handler decides whether to change scene.
